source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: F3c: steps of setOption (the first at T0; a next one after the previous ran out, T + 10000, or `after` ms into it; notMerge unless `merge`; `opts` added to the second argument), recorded at the last T + samples. Each element: an item path of a new series (id s<series>/<dataIndex>/<path>, the path its place in getPathList) or another path of its view (s<series>/x/<k>, owner the item whose group holds it); morph[i] = __morphT >= 0 and not combining, d[i] the replaced buildPath's PathProxy data (codes M1 L2 C3 Q4 A5 Z6 R7); comb[i] = __isCombineMorphing, pieces = its childrenRef() in order; style = the effective fill / stroke / lineWidth / opacity, snap = the path's transform and shape keys -- a key the same at every sample written once; text = the textContent's computed translation plus its style x / y, and its opacity. oldRest / newRest: every item path at rest before the last step and after it has run out (PathProxy data, computed transform). Every number is the hex of its double; a digest case writes a path as fnv<count>:<FNV-1a 32 of the hexes joined by ",">.

charts.note: four bars into a funnel of the same names: rects into polygons, one to one
and back
cartesian bars into radial bars on a polar (sectors), one seriesKey
polar bars into pie slices
pie slices into polar bars with roundCap (sausages)
pie slices into tangential polar bars with roundCap (Sausages: split as polygons)
and the sausages into bars, one seriesKey
polar bars with a border radius (rounded sectors) into cartesian bars
bars into repeated rect glyphs: one rect separates into each column's glyphs
and back: the glyphs combine into each bar
single circle glyphs (no repeat), turned, into pie slices
a map's regions into bars by name (a region of two polygons is one path; one with a hole too)
and back (the region no data names fades in)
bars into a custom series drawing a group of a rect and a circle per item: each bar separates into two
and the two combine into pie slices
a custom series of turned rects (a transform on the path) into bars
bars into lines (each a line path)
lines with end symbols (three paths an item) into pie slices
a bar series a and a funnel b combine into one pie whose seriesKey lists them
and the pie splits back into the bars and the funnel
pie slices into bars whose labels show on top: each label rides its bar's morph frame
vertical bars into horizontal ones under one seriesKey, the labels inside / right
bars into slices whose labels are outside (laid out by the pie, not by the slice)
a funnel into polar bars with labels inside
the same sunburst with a new palette: one view keeps its pieces -- each fades its style from the old one saved (animateElementStyles)
the same sunburst with other data (c and c1 gone, d new): the kept pieces restyle, d enters
the same treemap with other values and a new palette: one view, no style saved -- nothing of the transition
a bar series a into a pie b: no key pairs them, transition {from: seriesIndex 0, to: seriesIndex 0} does
the same by seriesId
the new series has universalTransition off: the transition option does not ask
from a series index the old option does not have: nothing transitions -- and the key batch, which would pair the same ids, is not asked either
two transitions in a list: a -> c and b -> d (two old bar series into two pies)
from two old series to one (a list of finders): their items pair by group
the new side reads the OLD series' dataGroupId at its index (transitionSeriesFromOpt): the old bars grouped g, the new pie grouped z -- both keyed g, many to many, by id one to one
a finder's dimension changes nothing (upstream reads it into groupIdDim and never uses it)
the same custom series with the transition option: its items are made anew (isUniversalTransitionEnabled for the series it names) and each morphs from its old element
200 ms into bars -> glyphs, the bars again: each bar combines the glyphs where they are
pictorialBar-bar-transition: the vehicles' glyphs into bars (merged, as the page does)
and the bars back into glyphs
map-bar-morph: the USA's states into bars (notMerge, as the page does)
and the bars back into states
pie-parliament-transition: each slice separates into its seats (merged, as the page does)
and the seats combine into the slices
